---
title: "Recent"
# Recent view: the newest content pages as cards, newest first (by `date`).
# Folder `index` pages are the Type views, not content, so they're excluded.
# `contents:` must list every folder in data/types.yml (Quarto can't read it).
# `max-items` must match RECENT_ITEMS in scripts/view_check.py.
listing:
  id: recent
  contents:
    - "topics/*.qmd"
    - "topics/*.md"
    - "dictionary/*.qmd"
    - "dictionary/*.md"
    - "essays/*.qmd"
    - "essays/*.md"
    - "prototypes/*.qmd"
    - "prototypes/*.md"
    - "tools/*.qmd"
    - "tools/*.md"
  exclude:
    filename: "index.qmd"
  type: grid
  sort: ["date desc", "title"]
  max-items: 10
  # No description: a card would repeat the page's opening paragraph.
  fields: [date, title]
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
---
